title: The Playground Through the Year
text:
In spring, the children go to the playground after school. The grass is green and the sun is warm. Tom likes the slide best. Anna likes to swing with her friend.

In winter, the playground is cold and quiet. There is snow on the slide. The children wear hats and coats. In summer, they play with water all afternoon.

questions.text: When do the children go to the playground after school?
What do the children wear in winter?
How does Anna probably feel at the playground in spring?
What can we guess about the playground in summer?
options: It is a place for water play

vocabulary.definition: an outdoor area where children play
a long smooth structure that children go down for fun
having a fairly high temperature, but not hot
to move back and forth while sitting or standing on a seat

paragraph_translations: Na primavera, as crianças vão ao parquinho depois da escola. A grama está verde e o sol está quente. O Tom gosta mais do escorregador. A Anna gosta de balançar com a amiga.
No inverno, o parquinho está frio e silencioso. Há neve no escorregador. As crianças usam chapéus e casacos. No verão, elas brincam com água a tarde toda.
